title: Invoice types
requirement: The system shall support order-based invoices (lines from order lines stamped 2-way or from approved receipt lines for 3-way), non-order invoices (coded lines), proforma invoices (referencing an order, consuming nothing) and credit notes (referencing an approved invoice); type decides creation path, validations and effects.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with 2-way and 3-way lines, When an invoice is created from it, Then 2-way lines take order quantities and 3-way lines offer approved receipt lines.|Given a credit note without reference, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a proforma, When approved, Then no bucket or budget changes.

title: Create invoice from orders
requirement: AP users and supplier users shall create an invoice from one or more orders of the same supplier with open 2-way lines (eligibility check), copying lines with open quantities and prices, allowing partial quantities, and appending further orders to a draft invoice of the same supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with open lines, When an invoice is created, Then a draft with those lines exists and the order is linked.|Given all lines invoiced, When created, Then "All lines of this order are already invoiced" is shown. (error case)|Given a draft of another supplier, When appending, Then it is refused.

title: Create invoice from receipts
requirement: For 3-way lines, invoices shall be built from approved receipt lines with open quantity, one invoice line per order line fed by one or more receipt lines (allocations summing to the line quantity), with the source picker showing pending-approval receipts as not yet billable.
acceptance_criteria: Given two approved receipts of 5 for one order line, When an invoice line of 10 is created, Then two source rows of 5 exist.|Given a receipt line in approval, When selected, Then it is shown as pending and cannot be used. (error case)|Given an allocation sum different from the line quantity, When saved, Then it is refused.

title: Non-order invoices
requirement: Non-order invoices shall require supplier, legal entity, chart of account, currency, supplier invoice number and date, and lines with description, amount, tax code and account splits totalling 100 percent; routing uses the invoice approval configuration; budget check applies when configured.
acceptance_criteria: Given complete coding, When submitted, Then it is Submitted and routed.|Given a line without splits, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given the tenant policy "orders required" or a supplier flagged "orders required", When a non-order invoice is created, Then it is refused or warned per the tenant or supplier setting (the supplier setting overrides the tenant setting).
notes: Was FF-113. Decision F-06 confirmed: policy at tenant and supplier level.

title: Proforma invoices
requirement: Proforma invoices reference an order, carry amounts for advance payment, follow approval, and never consume order quantities or budget; later final invoices may reference the proforma for netting (advance applied).
acceptance_criteria: Given a proforma approved, When the final invoice is created, Then the advance can be applied and the payable amount reduced.|Given a proforma without order, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a proforma, When buckets are viewed, Then nothing changed.

title: Invoice lines, taxes, charges, discounts and withholding
requirement: Lines (item or description, quantity, unit, unit price, tax code, account splits where needed), taxes at header or line level (one or the other), charges (freight, handling, other) at header or line, discounts and withholding at header or line, with totals computed and rounded per currency; the supplier's totals as printed shall be entered and compared to computed totals with a tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Given header taxes switched to line level, When saved, Then header tax lines are removed and line taxes required.|Given the entered total differs from the computed total beyond tolerance, When submitted, Then a warning or block applies per setting. (error case)|Given rounding, When totals compute, Then header equals the sum of rounded lines.

title: Account coding for invoice lines
requirement: Order-based lines inherit splits from order lines (editable only with permission); non-order lines require splits; a single chart of account per invoice is enforced when the setting is on.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order-based line, When viewed, Then splits equal the order line's splits.|Given the single-chart setting on and lines of two charts, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a user with the override permission, When splits are changed on an order-based line, Then the change is audited.

title: Payment terms, due dates and discounts
requirement: Invoices shall carry payment terms (from supplier or order), compute due date and early-payment discount date and amount, and lists shall flag invoices due within 7 days or overdue.
acceptance_criteria: Given net 30, When the invoice date is set, Then the due date is 30 days later.|Given a discount term, When viewed, Then the discount date and amount are shown.|Given an overdue unpaid invoice, When listed, Then it is flagged. (edge)|Given payment terms missing on the supplier and the order, When an invoice is submitted, Then it is refused until terms are set. (error case)
notes: Was FF-125. It keeps the due-date rules; the payment terms master is BF-072.

title: Invoice attachments and capture suggestions
requirement: Invoices shall store the supplier's PDF or image; when the AI capture feature is enabled, the AI service shall propose header and line values from the document as suggestions with confidence; the user confirms before any value is saved; suggestions and confirmations are audited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a PDF uploaded and capture enabled, When processed, Then suggestions appear marked as suggested with confidence.|Given the user confirms, When saved, Then the confirmed values are stored and the audit shows suggestion and confirmation.|Given the AI service unavailable, When processed, Then the user is told and enters values manually. (error case)

title: E-invoicing readiness
requirement: Invoice headers shall hold the fields needed for statutory e-invoices (for example registration numbers, place of supply, invoice reference number, QR code text, document type codes) as configurable fields per country, validated when the country rule is on.
rationale: Indian GST e-invoice and similar regimes; the Indian rules themselves arrive as an accelerator pack (BF-204).
acceptance_criteria: Given the India rule on and a missing invoice reference number on a B2B invoice above the threshold, When submitted, Then a warning or block applies per setting.|Given the rule off, When submitted, Then no e-invoice validation runs.|Given the fields present, When exported to the ERP, Then they are included. (edge)|Given an e-invoice field with an invalid format, When submitted with the rule on, Then it is refused naming the field. (error case)
notes: Was FF-129. It depends on the country packs (BF-204), whose e-invoice field rules it applies (ADR-0042). Decision F-08 confirmed.

title: Payment terms of micro and small suppliers (India)
requirement: For a supplier that the Indian pack classifies as a micro or small enterprise (BF-204), an invoice's due date shall be no later than 45 days after the day of acceptance (RCV-029) where the payment terms were agreed in writing, and 15 days after it where they were not; a longer term from the supplier or the order is cut to that limit, and the invoice shows the limit and why. An issued order's payment terms count as agreed in writing; a non-order invoice has none. The classification used is the one valid on the day of acceptance.
rationale: The MSMED Act's section 15 sets these limits, interest at three times the bank rate runs on what is paid late (section 16), and the Income-tax Act lets the buyer deduct a late payment to such a supplier only when it pays (section 43B(h)). Due dates that respect the law keep the buyer out of both.
acceptance_criteria: Given a micro supplier, an order with net 60 days and goods accepted on 1 June, When the invoice is created, Then its due date is 16 July, 45 days after acceptance, and the invoice shows the limit.|Given a small supplier and a non-order invoice for a service rendered on 1 June, When created, Then its due date is 16 June, 15 days after acceptance.|Given a medium enterprise or a trader, When an invoice is created, Then its terms are not cut.|Given a due date edited past the limit, When saved, Then it is refused naming the limit and the supplier's classification. (error case)
notes: New 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, gap G7 of the supplier management pack). Decision: an issued order's payment terms are the written agreement and a non-order invoice has none, and the classification is the one valid on the day of acceptance; to be confirmed by a practitioner in India before the pack is built.

title: Capacity checks at submission
requirement: On submission, for each order-based line the system shall lock the order line and source receipt lines in a fixed order and check: 2-way quantity ≤ open to invoice on the order line; 3-way allocations ≤ open on each receipt line and receipt lines approved; strict-invoice-once setting blocks any prior consumption; closed-for-invoicing lines refused; then update invoiced submitted buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given open 4 and an invoice of 4, When submitted, Then it passes and open becomes 0; an invoice of 5 is refused naming the line.|Given two invoices for the same last units submitted at once, When processed, Then exactly one succeeds.|Given strict mode and a line with any prior invoice, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Variance tolerances and holds
requirement: Submission shall check unit price, quantity, line amount and total amount variances against the stamped or configured tolerances (percentage or value); per tolerance type the action is block (refuse) or hold (submit with a hold reason that must be released by a permitted user before approval completes); holds are listed in a holds console.
acceptance_criteria: Given price variance 3 percent with tolerance 2 percent and action hold, When submitted, Then the invoice is Submitted with a price hold and approval cannot complete until release.|Given action block, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line and variance. (error case)|Given a hold released with reason, When approval completes, Then the release is in the audit.

title: Duplicate invoice check
requirement: No two live invoices (not cancelled or rejected) of the same supplier may share the supplier invoice number; a fuzzy check (same supplier, same amount, date within 7 days) shall warn.
rationale: Gap in the current product; standard control.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing live invoice with number X for supplier S, When another with X is submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given the earlier invoice is Cancelled, When submitted, Then it is allowed.|Given same amount within 7 days, When submitted, Then a warning asks for confirmation.

title: Stale match level and refresh
requirement: A draft invoice shall snapshot the match level of each order line; at submission a mismatch with the current stamp (possible only for lines approved later) refuses submission and the draft can be refreshed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stale snapshot, When submitted, Then it is refused with "Order line N changed; refresh the draft". (error case)|Given refresh, When done, Then the snapshot updates and lines are re-validated.|Given no change, When submitted, Then no refresh is needed.

title: Budget check for non-order invoices
requirement: Non-order invoices shall apply the budget check with reservation when invoice budget validation is on; order-based invoices do not consume again.
acceptance_criteria: Given validation on and short budget with blocking, When submitted, Then it is refused with the shortfall. (error case)|Given an order-based invoice, When submitted, Then no new reservation is made. (edge)|Given validation off, When submitted, Then no check runs.
notes: Was FF-121. AC1 is marked as the error case it is (ADR-0041).

title: Holds console
requirement: A console lists invoices on hold with reason, age, owner and release action requiring a reason; releasing is permission-controlled and audited.
acceptance_criteria: Given held invoices, When the console loads, Then they are listed by age.|Given release by a user without the permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given release, When done, Then approval can complete and the audit shows the reason.

title: Nightly reconciliation of the invoiced buckets
requirement: A nightly job shall recompute the invoiced buckets (invoiced submitted and invoiced approved, RCV-081) from invoices and credit notes, compare them with the stored values, write differences to a drift report and alert operators; drift is an incident, not auto-healed. It runs in the one nightly reconciliation window of the kernel's jobs (TF-120 to TF-124).
rationale: Counters are a cache; documents are the truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given consistent data, When the job runs, Then zero drift rows exist and a success record is stored.|Given a manual database change that breaks a counter, When the job runs, Then the drift row names the line and values and an alert fires. (error case)|Given the job fails, When detected, Then an alert fires.
notes: Was FF-133, the invoiced buckets; Orders, Receiving and the Business budgets reconcile their own counters in ORD-121, RCV-083 and BF-073, in the same window.

title: Invoice approval and disputes
requirement: Invoices shall run the invoice approval configuration with conditions (amount, supplier, variance flags, non-order flag, hold flags); approvers see lines, matched documents, variances and holds; a permitted user may mark an invoice Disputed with reason and resolve it back to Submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice with a hold, When all approvers approve, Then status remains pending until the hold is released. (edge)|Given a dispute, When marked, Then the supplier is notified with the reason.|Given rejection, When done, Then the invoice returns to Draft with the reason and buckets release submitted quantities.|Given a dispute marked by a user without the permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Cancel an invoice
requirement: Cancellation with reason shall be allowed in Draft, Submitted and Approved before payment release, releasing invoiced buckets and budget; after payment release only credit notes apply.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Approved invoice not released, When cancelled, Then buckets and budget are released.|Given an invoice released for payment, When cancel is attempted, Then it is refused with the credit note path. (error case)|Given cancellation, When audited, Then the reason is recorded.

title: Payment release and payment status
requirement: Approved invoices shall be released for payment by a permitted user (manual or automatic per setting) moving to Approved For Payment with a payment run reference; payment status (paid, partially paid, date, reference, amount) shall be received from the ERP through the API and shown on the invoice; fully paid invoices become Paid.
acceptance_criteria: Given release, When done, Then status is Approved For Payment and the event is published for the ERP.|Given a payment status for an unknown invoice, When received, Then it is rejected with an error. (error case)|Given partial payment, When received, Then status is Partially Paid with the paid amount.

title: Credit notes
requirement: Credit notes shall reference an approved or paid invoice (whole or lines), carry the supplier's credit note number (unique per supplier), run approval, and on approval reverse invoiced approved buckets and budget consumption as negative movement and publish an event for the ERP; source rows are never deleted.
rationale: Gap in the current product; required for returns and disputes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a credit note for 3 units of an invoiced line, When approved, Then invoiced approved decreases by 3 and the receipt line shows 3 open again.|Given a credit note above the invoiced quantity, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given approval, When done, Then an event is published with the reference to the original invoice.

title: Payment status codes from ISO 20022
requirement: Payment status messages shall carry ISO 20022 codes as optional reference attributes that integrations can rely on.
rationale: Common language with ERPs, suppliers and networks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment status message with an ISO 20022 code, When received, Then it maps to the invoice payment state.|Given a payment status message whose code is not an ISO 20022 payment status code, When received, Then it is rejected naming the code. (error case)
notes: Was FF-202, the payment status codes; the reference data of the masters is BF-205. AC2 is written for the split, after INV-043 AC2.

title: Bank account check at payment release
requirement: Releasing an invoice for payment (INV-043) shall ask Supplier management whether the payment's bank account may be paid on the payment date (SUP-164): verified and valid on that date, out of its cooling period, checked again when it changed within the re-check window, and the person releasing not one who requested or approved its change within the cooling period (TF-036). A release the answer refuses is refused with its reason; the payment instruction carries the account valid and verified on the payment date (BF-105).
rationale: Payment release is the last moment to stop money going to a fraudulent account; the check belongs there, and its answer belongs to the product that verified the account.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account in its cooling period, When an invoice to be paid to it is released, Then it is refused naming the first day the account may be paid. (error case)|Given an account changed 10 days ago, When an invoice is released, Then the account is checked again first, and the release completes when the check passes.|Given a person who approved the account's change two days ago, When they release a payment to it, Then it is refused naming the segregation rule. (error case)|Given an account verified and out of its period, When an invoice is released, Then the release completes with that account on the payment instruction.
notes: New 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, gap G5 of the supplier management pack). Invoicing calls Supplier management, the earliest product, through its Contracts (ADR-0042).

title: Matching configuration
requirement: Tenant settings shall define default match levels, receipt approval required, strict invoice-once, single chart per invoice, tolerance values and actions per type, duplicate fuzzy window, non-order invoice policy (tenant level, overridable per supplier), payment release mode and e-invoice rules; each setting shall be overridable per organisation where the Business PRD's section 2.2 allows.
acceptance_criteria: Given strict invoice-once switched on, When the next invoice is submitted, Then the strict rule applies.|Given a tolerance set to a negative value, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a setting changed, When 60 seconds pass, Then it applies without restart.

title: Matching and tolerance configuration screen
requirement: One screen for the matching configuration (INV-061) with explanations and a simulation that shows how a sample invoice would be treated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sample invoice entered in the simulation, When run, Then the outcome per check (pass, hold, block) is shown.|Given a change saved, When audited, Then it is recorded.|Given a user without the permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Invoice lists, queue and summaries
requirement: Lists (all, per order, per supplier, drafts, held, disputed, due) with saved views; an AP work queue of invoices needing action by age; summaries per invoice (totals, taxes, matched documents) and global (counts and amounts by status).
acceptance_criteria: Given invoices in several states, When the queue loads, Then items needing action appear with age and reason.|Given a supplier user, When listing, Then only their invoices appear.|Given global summary, When viewed, Then counts match the lists. (edge)|Given a user without invoice read permission, When the queue is opened, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: Was FF-126. It obeys the supplier portal's ownership rule, SPX-006, and depends on the kernel requirements that enforce it (ADR-0042).

title: Accrual report
requirement: A received-not-invoiced report per legal entity, period and account string shall compute (received approved − invoiced approved) × order price per line, excluding receipts pending approval, exportable and reconcilable to buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given received approved 10 and invoiced approved 6 at price 100, When the report runs, Then the line shows 400.|Given a receipt in approval, When the report runs, Then it is excluded.|Given export, When run, Then the file totals match the screen. (edge)|Given a user without the accrual report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Uninvoiced and open-order views
requirement: Views of orders and lines not fully invoiced and not fully received, with ages and supplier, to drive follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Given lines open to invoice, When the view loads, Then they are listed with open quantity and value.|Given a line closed for invoicing, When the view loads, Then it is excluded.|Given a filter by supplier, When applied, Then only that supplier's lines appear. (edge)|Given a user without order read permission, When the view is requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Operational reports
requirement: The reports in section 11.3 shall be available as grids with filters, saved views and export, respecting permissions and visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user without the reports permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given export, When run, Then the file matches the grid.
notes: Was FF-160, the invoicing reports; the others are REQ-061, ORD-081, RCV-101 and CAT-041. Placed by the test: each product owns its reports.

title: Invoice cycle time and first-pass match measures
requirement: The system shall compute the invoice to approval cycle time and the first-pass match rate (invoices approved without hold or rejection) by period, legal entity and supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given documents in a period, When computed, Then medians and percentiles are shown.|Given an invoice with a hold later released, When counted, Then it is not first-pass.|Given no data, When viewed, Then "no data" is shown. (edge)|Given a period with inconsistent data (an approval before submission), When computed, Then the record is excluded and listed in a data quality note. (error case)
notes: Was FF-161, the invoice measures; the order cycle times are ORD-082.

title: Ageing of what is owed to micro and small suppliers (India)
requirement: For suppliers the Indian pack classifies as micro or small (BF-204), a report shall age the unpaid amounts from their day of acceptance (RCV-029) in three bands, within 15 days, from 16 to 45 days, and over 45 days, per supplier and organisation, with totals; it is a report of section 11.3 (INV-084).
rationale: The limits of 15 and 45 days are the law's; finance needs to see what is about to cross them, and what has.
acceptance_criteria: Given unpaid invoices of a micro supplier accepted 10, 30 and 50 days ago, When the report runs, Then they fall in the bands within 15 days, 16 to 45 days, and over 45 days.|Given a supplier classified medium, When the report runs, Then it is not listed.|Given a user without the invoicing report permission, When the report is run, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: New 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, gap G7 of the supplier management pack).

title: Data for MSME Form 1 (India)
requirement: For each half-year (April to September, October to March), the product shall produce the data of the half-yearly MSME Form 1: for each micro or small supplier with amounts outstanding more than 45 days after their day of acceptance, its name, its PAN, the amount due, the date from which it is due, and the reason for the delay, which finance records on each such invoice.
rationale: A specified company files MSME Form 1 twice a year; its data are already in the invoices, the receipts and the supplier's classification.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice of a micro supplier accepted on 1 April, due on 16 May and unpaid on 30 September, When the April to September data is produced, Then it lists the supplier's name, its PAN, the amount and the date from which it is due, with the recorded reason.|Given an outstanding invoice over the limit without a reason recorded, When the data is produced, Then it is listed as missing its reason and finance is asked for one. (error case)|Given an invoice paid within 45 days of acceptance, When the data is produced, Then it is not listed.
notes: New 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, gap G7 of the supplier management pack). Decision: the form's fields as the pack's research log reads them; to be confirmed by a practitioner in India, with the filing rules, before the pack is built.

title: Invoice acknowledgement template
requirement: Invoicing shall name its document templates on the business layer's templates (BF-162): the invoice acknowledgement, which tells the supplier that an invoice was received and under which number, per legal entity and language, with the placeholders each offers documented and an English starter template of each; an invoice created from orders or receipts (INV-002, INV-003) is acknowledged through it.
rationale: Branded documents. A product's templates are its content; the template mechanism is the Foundation's (ADR-0043).
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice acknowledgement template for legal entity L1, When an invoice of L1 is received, Then the acknowledgement is rendered with that template.|Given a template that misses a placeholder Invoicing marks mandatory, When saved, Then it is refused naming the placeholder. (error case)|Given a preview, When requested, Then sample data renders.
notes: Was FF-173 and BF-162, the invoice acknowledgement template. Moved at the review of L2, 2026-10-20 (ADR-0043).

title: Notification keys of Invoicing
requirement: Invoicing shall declare its notification keys on the business layer's notification templates (BF-164), each with the event that raises it, the placeholders it offers, its default audience and an English starter template: invoice acknowledged (the supplier's primary contact, INV-121) and invoice disputed, with the reason (the supplier's primary contact, INV-041).
rationale: The product knows what happens to its documents; the tenant decides, in its own words, who hears of it (BF-164). A suite's keys and starter templates are the suite's content (ADR-0043).
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant with the eProcurement Suite, When it is provisioned, Then each key of Invoicing exists with its English starter template and its default audience.|Given an invoice marked disputed with a reason (INV-041), When it is saved, Then the supplier's primary contact is told with the reason in the key's template.|Given a starter template that names a placeholder its key does not offer, When the module's declarations are checked at start, Then the start fails naming the key and the placeholder. (error case)
notes: Was BF-164, the keys and starter templates of Invoicing. Moved at the review of L2, 2026-10-20 (ADR-0043): each product declares its keys and starter templates; BF-164 keeps the mechanism.

title: Invoices in the portal
requirement: Suppliers create order-based, receipt-based, proforma invoices and credit notes for their orders, upload their invoice document, see validations before submission, and track status, holds, disputes and payment status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with open lines, When the supplier creates an invoice, Then eligible lines are offered with open quantities.|Given a variance block, When submitted, Then the supplier sees the reason per line. (error case)|Given payment status received, When viewed, Then it is shown with date and reference.
notes: Was FF-155. It obeys the supplier portal's ownership rule, SPX-006, and depends on the kernel requirements that enforce it (ADR-0042).
